signals.source_text: But then he felt it—the vast presence touching currents of awareness that flowed through dimensions he was only beginning to perceive.
Torrhen was communing with forces so fundamental that they existed prior to the distinction between consciousness and reality itself.

The response came not as words but as invitation—harmonics that opened pathways through probability space, quantum channels that led toward communion with awareness so vast that individual identity seemed like temporary fluctuation in ocean of universal consciousness.
Harmonics that operated prior to the distinction between awareness and existence?
Throughout their partnership, their most advanced consciousness-crafting had operated through principles that seemed to exist beyond systematic analysis.
It was reality speaking to itself, consciousness recognizing its own nature through harmonic resonance that created meaning by being rather than by representing.
